# Coop public API

A normalized snapshot of the **Tier-1 compatibility surface** (coop#7): every name
reachable from the entry barrel `src/index.ts`, plus the `DefaultTheme` augmentation
of `styled-components`. Anything that makes existing consumer code fail to typecheck —
a removed or renamed export, a new required prop, a narrowed prop type, a changed
callback signature, a change to the theme’s shape — changes this file.

This report is the gate: `yarn coop:api` regenerates it, and CI fails when the
committed copy is stale, so a surface change is always visible as a diff in the pull
request that makes it. Regenerating is half the ritual — when the change breaks
consumers, the other half is the **Breaking** entry in `CHANGELOG.md`. The gate makes
changes visible; the changelog is where a human says what they mean.

Interfaces list their **declared** members; inherited DOM attributes are carried by the
`extends` clause. The theme prints its **shape**, never its token values — token values
are outside the promise.

## Internal types reached by the surface (4)

Not exported — a consumer cannot import these — but each one appears inside the
resolved type of something that is, so narrowing one still breaks consumer code.
They are part of the gated surface for that reason alone.

```ts
type Align = 'center' | 'left' | 'right'

interface ComboboxCommonProps {
  'aria-label'?: string
  className?: string
  creatable?: boolean
  debounceMs?: number
  disabled?: boolean
  hasError?: boolean
  id?: string
  loading?: boolean
  onCreate?: (value: string) => void
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void
  options: ComboboxOption[]
  placeholder?: string
}

interface DateRangeValue {
  end: string
  start: string
}

type FieldStatus = 'error' | 'success' | 'warning'
```
